visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black baseball cap and an olive green t-shirt stands outdoors in a harbor, gesturing with his right hand as he speaks. Beside him, a woman with long black hair wearing a dark blue sleeveless top listens. Behind them, numerous white and blue fishing boats are docked at a concrete pier under bright natural daylight. (2) A second man, wearing a blue t-shirt and a grey cap, enters the frame and begins explaining. He uses broad hand gestures. The camera alternates between medium shots of the three individuals and wide shots of the harbor with green hills in the distance. (3) A close-up shot shows a greyish-white rock on the ground. A metal rod touches it, causing a small, flickering orange flame to ignite on its surface. This is followed by a shot of large, clear glass light bulbs hanging from a blue metal frame on a boat. (4) On a boat at sea, a large metal pipe suddenly erupts with a massive, blinding orange flame accompanied by thick white smoke. The man and woman from the first phase are seen reacting with shock, their mouths wide open and bodies flinching away from the heat. (5) Transition to a night scene at sea. The boat's fire flare illuminates the dark water, revealing hundreds of small, silvery fish jumping frantically into the air and into a large fishing net. The scene is high-contrast, lit only by the intense fire.

(2) A female voice (Lin Zhenyi) enters with a higher pitch and playful intonation, making a sharp 'Bang!' vocal SFX to mimic an explosion. (3) Male voice 2 (Jian Shikai) begins a professional, educational narration with a lower pitch and clear articulation. The background audio remains clean with minimal ambient interference. (4) A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM fades in, maintaining a steady rhythmic pulse. (5) A sudden, high-intensity 'WHOOSH' sound effect triggers as the fire ignites, followed immediately by a sharp, loud burst sound. Multiple voices scream and cheer in a state of high arousal. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce and showcase the traditional and unique 'Sulfur Fire Fishing' (Bong-ho-zai) culture in Jinshan, Taiwan, through a combination of lighthearted entertainment and educational storytelling.
